action_instruction: Checking for the tip-adjustment badge on the order
intent: whether the order includes the tip-adjustment badge

action_params.condition: the order shows a badge reading "Tip adjusted after delivery"
action_params.query: whether the order includes the tip-adjustment badge

action_instruction: Reading the tip amount from the order summary
intent: the tip amount in the order summary

action_params.condition: the order now shows a tip of "$8.00"
action_params.query: the tip amount in the order summary

assertion_tree.description: the order now shows a tip of "$8.00" and a badge reading "Tip adjusted after delivery"

sub_results.description: the order now shows a tip of "$8.00"
the order shows a badge reading "Tip adjusted after delivery"

assertion_tree.verification: The current order displays a tip of "$8.00" and a badge reading "Tip adjusted after delivery".
